focusedAudit.reason: Martin authorized the stable patch release on 2026-11-22 (D-20261122-092). The release checklist reserves audits for maintainer requests.

items.text: The main window and additional graph windows can now be resized down to 390 pt wide on desktop (#1005).

regressionEvidence.reason: The native test covers the minimum width. The catalog records Linux evidence for a routed page and the sidebar overlays. macOS tiling and Windows runtime remain unverified.

docs.reason: The Guide records the new minimum width for desktop graph windows.

website.reason: The public Guide includes the new desktop window width.

blog.reason: Covered in the patch release notes.

items.text: Configured Hiccup macros render bare-word arguments like `{{r education}}`, just like their quoted equivalents (#1018).

regressionEvidence.reason: The render and Hiccup tests cover inline and block output, bare and quoted arguments, and malformed symbols that remain literal.

docs.reason: The existing Hiccup examples remain valid. The release note records the bare-word fix.

website.reason: The public Guide's Hiccup examples remain valid.

blog.reason: Covered in the patch release notes.

items.text: Enter at the end of an expanded block embed adds a visible first child and moves the caret there, even when the source is folded (#1023).

regressionEvidence.reason: The render regression checks first-child order, caret focus in the embed, the source fold, and one-step Undo.

docs.reason: The Guide describes Enter and Undo in an expanded embed.

website.reason: The public Guide includes the expanded-embed instructions.

blog.reason: Covered in the patch release notes.

items.text: Distribution packagers can build the PDF decoder with Debian trixie's Emscripten 3.1.69 using `TINE_PDFJS_EMCC` (#1027).

regressionEvidence.reason: The build and ABI tests cover the packager compiler override and the older decoder interface. The catalog records matching JPEG 2000 output with the pinned and packager toolchains.

docs.reason: The build notes document the Debian compiler and the packager override.

website.reason: The change applies when building distribution packages.

blog.reason: Covered in the patch release notes.
